name: toolbox
description: Browse reviewed FrameCore Works tools by task, check their installation route, and run the built-in Earshot audio capability.

interface.longDescription: Browse the FrameCore Works tool catalog in Claude, ChatGPT Work or Codex. Choose tools by task and check their host-specific installation notes. Catalog entries are independently installed; their runtime compatibility is verified separately. Earshot (local audio measurement, selection and sound kits) is built in and needs a consented, pinned local setup.
interface.defaultPrompt: Pokaż narzędzia Toolboxa i sposób ich instalacji w tym środowisku.
